title: Sunday · the lamp on the beach
logline: The green swing-arm lamp on the beach at dusk, clamped to the drift log, lit from an extension cord that runs off the page. The strip's absurd object, drawn as a landscape with dignity.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the drift log at dusk with a green swing-arm lamp clamped to it, lit, its cord running away up the beach off the page, and a man and a dog in its circle of light.

image.prompt: a bleached drift log on a beach at dusk with a green swing-arm desk lamp clamped to it and lit, its cord running off the page, a man and a dog sitting in its small circle of light, no words

panels.name: Lamp

panels.composition: Tier 2: the circle of light on the sand, a pad in it, a hand drawing.

image.prompt: a circle of lamplight on sand with a drawing pad and a hand drawing in it, no words

panels.name: Circle

panels.composition: Tier 3: the beach from far off: one small light on a dark beach, the sea. Held.

image.prompt: a dark beach at dusk seen from far off with one small warm light on it and the sea beyond, no words

panels.name: Far

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The lamp on the log, lit. One light on a dark beach.
